source_document: Approved Sessions 6–8 Evidence-Integrity Closeout — Final Execution Plan

requirements.source_requirement: deterministic blocker authority and actionability
requirements.normative_behavior: Only policy-derived authoritative facts classify actionable remediation.

requirements.source_requirement: planner content never changes compiler-owned issue authority
requirements.normative_behavior: Planner content remains reviewer-authored and optional.

requirements.source_requirement: ordinary human is not owner authority
requirements.normative_behavior: Only release-bound authority grants owner-declared semantics.

requirements.source_requirement: bounded fixes are metadata only
requirements.normative_behavior: Automation eligibility never opens a private-alpha write route.

requirements.source_requirement: one remediation packet and closure contract per actionable issue
requirements.normative_behavior: Packets, contracts, and projections are unique and bidirectionally linked.

requirements.source_requirement: closure requires exact passing independent rerun
requirements.normative_behavior: Wrong, stale, failed, or self-verified evidence cannot satisfy closure.

requirements.source_requirement: private alpha closure does not close canonical findings
requirements.normative_behavior: Closure result is candidate-only and preserves canonical facts.

requirements.source_requirement: fixed native specialist catalogue
requirements.normative_behavior: Every specialist binds an exact native result boundary.

requirements.source_requirement: native intent packet wrapper lifecycle
requirements.normative_behavior: Wrapper transports native proposals without compiling or strengthening intent.

requirements.source_requirement: typed evidence selects specialists
requirements.normative_behavior: Absence remains not inspected; typed evidence governs selection.

requirements.source_requirement: Python and TypeScript plans differ materially
requirements.normative_behavior: Language signals generate distinct specialist scopes and plan identities.

requirements.source_requirement: typed AI surface selection
requirements.normative_behavior: AI review is selected or precise unavailable, never passed as not inspected.

requirements.source_requirement: browser skip is explicit
requirements.normative_behavior: Browser skip requires explicitly_not_applicable evidence.

requirements.source_requirement: Codex execution package is transport-only
requirements.normative_behavior: Rendered package binds native context and cannot execute harnesses.

requirements.source_requirement: two-attempt revision state machine
requirements.normative_behavior: Corrected second submissions accept; second invalid submissions fail closed.

requirements.source_requirement: submission bytes and validation persist
requirements.normative_behavior: Every submission attempt retains result, receipt, validation, and hash.

requirements.source_requirement: migration adaptation has material successor effect
requirements.normative_behavior: Migration trigger changes plan and work-order state while preserving history.

requirements.source_requirement: AI adaptation is trigger specific
requirements.normative_behavior: AI trigger only creates authorized AI-scoped successor work.

requirements.source_requirement: browser disproven adaptation supersedes prior work
requirements.normative_behavior: Browser work is retained as superseded and becomes explicitly not applicable.

requirements.source_requirement: manual and Codex routes share validator semantics
requirements.normative_behavior: Equivalent submissions produce equal semantic identities and distinct provenance.

requirements.source_requirement: contestation targets resolve through registry
requirements.normative_behavior: Only registered current-release targets and relevant accepted evidence are actionable.

requirements.source_requirement: contestation preserves source facts
requirements.normative_behavior: Actions are idempotent append-only references and do not rewrite facts.

requirements.source_requirement: owner actions use release-bound authority
requirements.normative_behavior: Actor text, email, or receipt cannot establish owner authority.

requirements.source_requirement: owner decision budget is deterministic and complete
requirements.normative_behavior: Two immediate decisions and all overflow records preserve source links and priority.

requirements.source_requirement: management uses one exact dependency vector
requirements.normative_behavior: Mixed, stale, and omitted dependency vectors are rejected.

requirements.source_requirement: management sections are substantive and complete
requirements.normative_behavior: Section cardinality, matrix coverage, exact passthrough, and typed empties follow registry policy.

requirements.source_requirement: recommendation policy is deterministic derived view
requirements.normative_behavior: Recommendation never mutates canonical release facts.

requirements.source_requirement: management JSON HTML Markdown rendering is deterministic and safe
requirements.normative_behavior: Renderers escape untrusted content and use no active or remote resources.

requirements.source_requirement: trusted reads writes and pointer preservation
requirements.normative_behavior: All persisted lifecycle state validates trusted ancestry, capacity, exact file sets, and pointer-last publication.

requirements.source_requirement: all discovered parity contracts execute boundaries and mutations
requirements.normative_behavior: Every parity contract has actual schema/Python/stateful acceptance and isolated rejection evidence.

requirements.source_requirement: prohibited operations have honest dynamic security proofs
requirements.normative_behavior: Guarded or unreachable operations have typed rejection and unchanged real state.

requirements.source_requirement: installed wheel runs connected lifecycle outside checkout
requirements.normative_behavior: Clean installed distribution runs all required connected commands with bound artifacts.

requirements.source_requirement: proof receipt binds final JUnit and artifacts
requirements.normative_behavior: Valid near-valid and adversarial proofs are independently distinguishable.

requirements.source_requirement: independent report and receipt validator recomputes closure
requirements.normative_behavior: Validator does not trust report resolved status or share closure semantics with generator.
